title: "dplyr recap: select() and filter() (worksheet)"
format: html

Replace each `___` with code, remove `#| eval: false` and run the chunk. Write your answer under each chunk.

The data are all flights that departed from New York in 2013. They come from the `nycflights13` package.

```{r}
#| label: setup
pacman::p_load(
  here,            # file paths that work on any computer
  tidyverse,       # ggplot2, dplyr, tidyr and friends
  nycflights13     # all flights departing New York City in 2013
)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
# flights comes from the nycflights13 package, so no csv file is needed
flights <- nycflights13::flights
```

## Your turn 1: select a range

Select the columns from `dep_time` to `arr_delay`.

```{r}
#| label: turn-1a
flights |>
  select(dep_time:arr_delay)
```

Answer: 6 columns.

Select all columns except `dep_time` to `arr_delay`.

```{r}
#| label: turn-1b
flights |>
  select(!dep_time:arr_delay)
```

Answer: 13 columns.

## Your turn 2: select by pattern

Select the columns that end in `time`.

```{r}
#| label: turn-2a
flights |>
  select(ends_with("time"))
```

Answer: 5 columns.

Select the columns that start with `sched`.

```{r}
#| label: turn-2b
#| eval: false
flights |>
  select(starts_with("sched"))
```

Answer: [YOUR ANSWER HERE] columns.

## Your turn 3: AND and OR

Flights that departed on December 25.

```{r}
#| label: turn-3a
flights |>
  filter(month == 12 & day == 25) |>
  filter(dep_delay > 0)
```

Flights that departed in June or July, with `|`.

```{r}
#| label: turn-3b
flights |>
  filter(month == 6 | month == 7) |>
  filter(origin == "JFK")
```

The same flights as the previous question, with `%in%`.

```{r}
#| label: turn-3c
flights |>
  filter(month %in% c(6, 7))
```

Answer: both versions return 57,668 rows. Check it with `count()`.

## Your turn 4: NOT

Flights that did not depart from JFK.

```{r}
#| label: turn-4a
flights |>
  filter(origin != "JFK") |>
  count(origin)
```

Answer: 2 airports remain.

Flights that did not depart from JFK or LGA.

```{r}
#| label: turn-4b
flights |>
  filter(!(origin %in% c("JFK", "LGA"))) |>
  count(origin)
```

Answer: EWR is the only airport left.

## See the distribution of dep delay from JFK in Christmas time

```{r}
#| label: jfk-christmas-delays
flights |>
  filter(origin == "JFK") |>             # this is the airport
  filter(month == 12 & day == 25) |>     # this is Christmas Day
  filter(!is.na(dep_delay)) |>           # drop flights with no delay recorded
  ggplot(aes(x = dep_delay)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10, fill = "#2a6fdb", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Departure delays from JFK on December 25, 2013",
    x = "Departure delay (minutes)",
    y = "Number of flights"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
